title: Trustee intake of a ballot record: admission with its membership proof, the share hash, decryption and the share receipt
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/intake-vectors.py, an implementation of Intake and receipts with Python's integers and hashlib, reusing this folder's independent ballot-vectors.py and ballot-v2-vectors.py (elections, electorates, records, signals), share-encryption-vectors.py (KEM keys, encryption, decryption) and share-receipt-vectors.py (the receipt and its RFC 6979 P-256 signature); membership proofs by packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-proofs.mjs, run outside the workspace with Semaphore 4.14.3's depth-32 circuit artifacts and snarkjs 0.7.5's fullProve, and every pairing verdict is snarkjs's groth16.verify on the signals derived here from the record. The delivery-malformed cases are labelled by hand from the strict-decoding rules
